output.reason_for_conversation: strategies for managing work performance during cognitive symptoms
output.summary: User with fibromyalgia described severe brain fog affecting accounting work—losing her train of thought in meetings, forgetting details, making errors—and feared job loss. The bot offered practical workplace strategies (external memory systems, verification routines, task batching, protected focus time) and explored root causes. User revealed unrefreshed sleep despite 8 hours and husband-observed snoring with breathing pauses, raising strong suspicion of obstructive sleep apnea. Bot flagged this as a priority medical issue warranting sleep study evaluation. User also mentioned nightly diphenhydramine use; bot identified it as anticholinergic and potentially contributing to cognitive fog, recommending discussion with her doctor. User left with a prioritized action plan: book sleep study, discuss medication with doctor, start workplace strategies, and explore confidential accommodation request through HR.
